Sep 2025 • Couples
We're here for feedback, for good reason! Every dish is a masterpiece! The atmosphere is very cozy, the waiters are friendly, although there are a lot of people. They took flying noodles, springrolls and tom pit pizza, and he had mango smoothies and guava juice. 
The noodles impressed not only with the serving but also with the taste. The pizza dough is right, thin, but not dry. Spring rolls are good for PP devotees. Juice and sourness, very refreshing, but a smoothie deserves its own chapter! 
This was not found in Goa, in any of the resorts of Thailand, or in his native Moscow) Pure mango, only ground in a blender. Just a gun! 
All in all, a well-deserved A for this place. We'll be back for sure. By the way, the bill for all this beauty is also nice: 362,000 dong in total.

Only smoothie tasted good for 50 tons.
Aug 2025 • Family
We ordered tom pit soup, shrimp noodles, pizza and fish in a beer cart. 
Tom yam-coconut sweet water with mushrooms and 4 small shrimp. An authentic Thai dish has nothing to do with it, edible, but nothing more.
Shrimp noodles are not good at all, an abundance of sauce.
Pizza is terrible, how can it be praised? Dry unleavened crusts, they don't know about the sauce.
The paper-like fish, dry, decaying and completely unsalted, were not finished at the next table either. Nice fries! And a smoothie banana maracuya. 
And the worst part is the service. First we got the noodles, the baby ate them, and there were no drinks, we had to call the waiter and talk about it. Pizza was brought, then just drinks. And at the end, they brought 2 volumes of pits out of 3 ordered. It came back in five minutes. Finally, there was a fish that, after abundant tacky food, no longer wanted to taste. 
The tables are sticky, the elevator you take to the cafe, haven't washed in 40 years, everything smells unpleasant. The air conditioning and fan can't handle it, it's stuffy. A terrible unpleasant experience.
